['Select molecule_chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles', 'From molecule_dictionary md', 'Join activities a ON md.molregno = a.molregno', 'Join assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id', 'Join target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid', "Filter td.pref_name = 'human serine/threonine-protein kinase PLK1' AND td.tax_id = 9606", 'Join compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno', 'Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles', 'Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles', 'Limit 2000']
